name: cellosaurus_search_cell_lines
description: Search Cellosaurus cell lines using the /search/cell-line endpoint. Supports Solr query syntax for precise field-based searches.

q.description: Search query. Supports Solr syntax for field-specific searches (e.g., 'id:HeLa', 'ox:9606', 'char:cancer'). See https://api.cellosaurus.org/api-fields for available fields.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination)

size.description: Maximum number of results to return

fields.description: Field abbreviations to return, e.g. ['id','ac','ox','ca']. A full record is very large (one HeLa hit is roughly 670 KB), so restrict this whenever the whole record is not needed. See https://api.cellosaurus.org/api-fields.

total.description: Total number of matching cell lines

query.description: The search query that was executed

name: cellosaurus_query_converter
description: Convert natural language queries to Solr syntax for Cellosaurus API searches. Uses semantic similarity to map terms to appropriate fields.

query.description: Natural language query to convert to Solr syntax (e.g., 'human cancer cells', 'HeLa cells from lung tissue')

include_explanation.description: Whether to include detailed explanation of the conversion process

is_valid.description: Whether the generated Solr query is valid

validation_message.description: Validation message for the Solr query

transformations_applied.description: List of transformations applied to the query

available_fields.description: List of available Cellosaurus field tags

name: cellosaurus_get_cell_line_info
description: Get detailed information about a specific cell line using its Cellosaurus accession number (CVCL_ format).

fields.description: Specific fields to retrieve (e.g., ['id', 'ox', 'char']). If not specified, all fields are returned.

data.description: The Cellosaurus cell-line record as the API sends it. Which keys are present depends on the fields argument; the keys below are those a full record carries.

accession-list.description: Every accession the cell line holds; one is type 'primary', the others are secondary accessions kept for lookups.

child-list.description: Cell lines derived from this one (2273 for CVCL_0030), each with its accession and name.

comment-list.description: Curator comments by category: 'Problematic cell line', 'Misspelling', 'Omics', 'Karyotypic information' and others. This is where Cellosaurus records a contamination or misidentification warning.

derived-from-site-list.description: Body site the line was derived from, with its site-type (In situ, Metastatic).

disease-list.description: Diseases of the donor as NCI Thesaurus terms with accessions.

doubling-time-list.description: Reported doubling times with the reference each came from; values disagree between sources.

hla-typing-list.description: HLA alleles per gene, each typing with its source.

name-list.description: Names of the cell line: one 'identifier' plus synonyms.

omics-list.description: Omics studies available for the line, by branch (Genomics, Transcriptomics, ...).

reference-list.description: The cell line's references as Cellosaurus internal pointers ({'resource-internal-ref': 'CelloPub=CLPUB00047'}). Read publications for the records these point at.

species-list.description: Species of origin as NCBI Taxonomy cross-references.

transformant-list.description: Transforming agent (virus, oncogene) as a cross-reference; for CVCL_0030 human papillomavirus type 18.

web-page-list.description: External pages about the line, by category and institution.

xref-list.description: Cross-references to other resources (233 for CVCL_0030): cell line catalogues, anatomy and cell-type ontologies, omics repositories.

age.description: Donor age at sampling, as Cellosaurus writes it (e.g. '30Y6M').

category.description: Cell line category, e.g. 'Cancer cell line', 'Hybridoma', 'Finite cell line'.

entry-version.description: Cellosaurus version number of this entry.

last-updated.description: Date the entry was last updated.

doubling-time-range.description: Doubling time as a range where Cellosaurus records one.

genome-ancestry.description: Estimated genome ancestry proportions with the study they came from.

str-list.description: Short tandem repeat profile: the marker/allele pairs used to authenticate the line, with their sources.

publications.description: The publications the cell line's reference-list points at, resolved against the response's own publication list. Cellosaurus sends the references as internal pointers ('CelloPub=CLPUB00047') and the publication records separately, so the pointers alone carry no title, journal or PubMed id. An unresolvable pointer is reported as its bare internal id.

internal_id.description: The Cellosaurus internal reference the cell line pointed at.

type.description: Publication type (article, thesis, patent, book chapter).

authors.description: Author names, at most AUTHORS_PER_PUBLICATION of them.

author_count.description: Number of authors the record carries.

cross_references.description: Identifiers for the publication: its PubMed id, DOI and the resolvable URL for each.

category.description: Cellosaurus's category for the resource, e.g. 'Reference resources'.

publication_count.description: Number of references the cell line carries (83 for CVCL_0030); publications holds at most the first PUBLICATIONS_PER_CELL_LINE of them.

publications_truncated.description: True when publication_count exceeds the number of records in publications.
